Asset type: original pixel-art game sprite atlas for Brokk Town.
Create ONE image, a precisely aligned 3-column by 2-row sprite atlas, overall 1536 by 1024 pixels. Six equal 512 by 512 cells. Genuine transparent alpha background (no checkerboard rendering, no solid color backdrop). No visible cell borders.
In each cell, center ONE distinct cozy village building, generous fully transparent margin on every side, all building pixels within the central 400 by 400 area of its cell. Keep exact evenly spaced cell center points at (256,256), (768,256), (1280,256), (256,768), (768,768), (1280,768).
